plc.title: PLC (Modbus TCP)
plc.intro: {gates}: amasango okumisa athatha imiyalo yokuvula nokuvala kusuka ku-PLC. I-PLC ifunda ama-photo-eye nama-counter bese ibhala ama-coil wamasango; imodeli isebenza ngesivinini sewashi. Ifekthri ayinamandla: i-PLC ayikwazi ukwenza ibhande lishesha.
plc.nogate: Setha imodi yesango lokumisa ibe "Imiselwe yi-PLC" ukuze i-PLC iliphathe. Ama-photo-eye sewakwazi ukufundwa.
plc.start.hint: I-Studio ilalela i-PLC kulolu komputha ngenkathi ukusebenza okuphilayo kuqhubeka
plc.studio: I-PLC ixhuma nge-CadCraft Studio, evula isokhethi kulolu komputha. Lapha ungalondoloza uhlu lwezikhombisi kumhlelikhompuyutha we-PLC.
plc.nolink: Lolu hlelo alunalo uxhumano lwe-PLC (sebenzisa i-CadCraft Studio kudeskithophu).

pools.note: Iqembu labantu abasetshenziswa amaziteshi ngokwabelana. Isiteshi esibiza iqembu sidinga umuntu ovela kulo ngayo yonke imithwalo esiyisebenzelayo; uma kungekho muntu okhululekile, imithwalo iyalinda.

robot.title: Iseli lerobhothi
robot.none: Alikho irobhothi okwamanje. Engeza iseli ukuze uhlole ukuthi yimaphi amaziteshi lifinyelela nokuthi ukukhetha nokubeka kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani.

robot.note: Ukuhlaziywa kwendlela kuphela: alubheki ukushaywa, umthwalo noma amandla okunyakaza. Izikhathi zisebenzisa izinga lokusheshisa nesivinini salo lonke ilunga; ziwukulinganisa kokuhlela, hhayi inombolo yomlawuli womkhiqizi. Uhlelo ungumbhalo wefomethi engathathi hlangothi; alubhalwa ngolimi lomkhiqizi werobhothi.
robotx.table.dh: Umugqa owodwa ngalunye welunga, i-Denavit-Hartenberg yakudala: ubude bomzila a, ukugoba alpha, ukuthambeka d, ukushintshwa kwe-engeli, bese kuba imikhawulo yamalunga nemikhawulo yesivinini. Izinguquko zisebenza ngokushesha futhi zilondolozwa kanye nomdwebo.
robotx.table.scara: Ubude bezingalo ezimbili, uhla lobude besilayidi kanye nohla lwama-engeli ezimbili zengalo.
robotx.table.delta: Usayizi wesisekelo nephlatifomu, ubude bengalo nezinti (Clavel) kanye nohla lobude lokusebenza (kungaba negethivu: ngaphansi kwesisekelo).
robotx.table.cartesian: Uhla lokuhamba kwesilayidi ngasinye ohlakeni lwerobhothi lwayo.
robotx.fmt.title: Amafomethi ohlelo
robotx.fmt.hint: Khetha amafayela okulondoloza kulesi selula. Uhlu lwendlela lulondolozwa njalo. Ukukhetha kwakho kugcinwa kanye nomdwebo futhi kukhunjulwe njengokuzenzakalelayo kwakho.
robotx.fmt.unverified: Izinhlelo zezilimi zerobhothi zincane futhi azikaqinisekiswa: zakhiwe kusuka kumodeli engenhla, akukaze zisebenze ku-robhothi yi-CadCraft. Lingisa futhi uqinisekise kumlawuli wakho werobhothi ngaphambi kokusebenzisa. Akuvunywa yinkampani yanoma yiyiphi irobhothi.

plcmode.title: Imodi ye-PLC
plcmode.safety.title: Ukulingisa kuphela.
plcmode.safety: Ungalokothi ushayele imishini yangempela ngaphandle kokunakwa kulokhu kulingisa, futhi ungalokothi wethembele kukho ukuphepha: ukuma kwesimo esiphuthumayo lapha kuwukufaka kokuhlola. Unesibopho ngalokho okwenziwa yi-PLC exhunyiwe.
plcmode.noengine: Injini ethambile ye-PLC (amafayela wedijithali ephindaphindiwe) ayikwazanga ukulayishwa kulolu hlelo, ngakho imodi ye-PLC ayikwazi ukusebenza lapha.
plcmode.tags: Amathegi: {inputs} ahamba kusukela kumodeli aye kwi-PLC (amehlo wesithombe, ukufunda kwamasango, abalayo); {outputs} ayabuya (imiyalo yokuvula yamasango).
plcmode.nogate: Akukakho sango lokuma kwimodi ye-PLC okwamanje. Setha imodi yesango ibe "Isethwe yi-PLC" ukuze umlawuli alishayele.
plcmode.soft.intro: I-PLC ethambile isebenzisa uhlelo lwakho kumodeli, kulesi windi noma e-Studio, ngaphandle kwe-hardware. Bhala i-Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) noma unamathisele i-PLCopen XML. Uma kungekho hlelo, kusetshenziswa uhlelo lokuqala.
plcmode.soft.run.hint: Iyaphindeka: uhlelo nembewu efanayo kunikeza umphumela ofanayo, ngokushesha kunesikhathi sangempela
plcmode.soft.attach.hint: Qala i-Live kuqala ku-Run; khona i-PLC ethambile izoskena ngewashi lemodeli
plcmode.soft.attached: I-PLC ethambile ishayela amasango womsebenzi ophilayo.
plcmode.soft.ended: Umsebenzi ophilayo uphelile, ngakho i-PLC ethambile iyame.
plcmode.needLive: Qala i-Live kuqala ku-Run: i-PLC ikhuluma nemodeli njengoba isebenza ngesivinini sewashi.
plcmode.needAck: Faka itiki kuqala ebhokisini: ukulingisa kuphela, futhi unesibopho.
plcmode.real.intro: Imodeli idlala isitshalo, i-PLC yangempela idlala umlawuli. Kulo ngayinye umjikelezo izinzwa zemodeli zibhalelwa kuma-coil namarejista e-PLC bese ama-coil okuphuma e-PLC afundwa abuyele kumasango. I-Studio ivula uxhumo; i-PLC kumele ibe kulolu khompyutha noma kunethiwekhi eyimfihlo.
plcmode.real.browser: Imodi yangempela idinga i-CadCraft Studio: ithebhu yesiphequluli ayikwazi ukuvula uxhumo lwe-TCP olungahlelwanga. Imodi ethambile isebenza ngokuphelele lapha.
plcmode.real.oldStudio: I-CadCraft Studio le ayinaklayenti le-PLC okwamanje; idinga ukwakha kwe-0.9. Imodi ethambile isebenza lapha.
plcmode.hostNote: Ikheli nochweba kuhlala kulolu khompyutha. Azigcinwa kwifayela lemodeli, futhi awukho umaphasiwedi: i-Modbus TCP ayinawo.
plcmode.problem.wrong_table: {tag}: i-Studio ibhala ama-coil namarejista okubamba kuphela.
plcmode.problem.bad_type: {tag}: i-coil noma okokufaka okungokudijithali kuphethe ibhithi.
plcmode.ack: Ngiyaqonda: ukulingisa kuphela, ungalokothi ngingabi khona, futhi nginesibopho ngalokho i-PLC ekwenzayo.
plcmode.real.connect.hint: Kudinga umsebenzi ophilayo, imephu ehlanzekile kanye nebhokisi elimakiwe
plcmode.real.ended: Umsebenzi ophilayo uphelile, ngakho uxhumo lwe-PLC lunqanyuliwe.
plcmode.note: I-PLC ayikwazi ukwenza ibhande lihambe ngokushesha: imithwalo ihamba ngokwe-kinematics. Lokhu akuyona ukuqinisekiswa kokuphepha.
problem.orders-missing: {id} isethelwe ukuthatha ama-oda kusuka efayelini, kodwa akukho thebula lama-oda elikhethiwe. Vula ifayela lama-oda esigabeni se-Orders bese ukhetha lapha.
problem.orders-empty: {id} isethelwe ukuthatha ama-oda kusuka efayelini, kodwa ithebula alinalo nhlanhla yalo (umugqa ongenayo ikholomu yomthombo uya kuwo wonke amathuba anjalo).
orders.title: Ama-oda avela efayelini
orders.note: Ukufika kusuka kufayela le-CSV esikhundleni sezikhathi ezingahleliwe: setha umthombo ube ngu-Ama-oda avela efayelini bese ukhetha ithebula. Umugqa wokuqala uqamba amakholomu: time_s, time_min, time_h noma time (lapho kufika, kubalwa kusukela ekuqaleni kokusebenza), noma clock (h:mm:ss, kubalwa kusukela komugqa wokuqala); type, length_m noma length_mm, qty, source (i-id yomthombo) kanye no-order (ilebula). Kudingeka ikholomu yesikhathi kuphela. Ifayela elifanayo linika ukusebenza okufanayo. Uma umugqa ungafundeka, akukho okulayishwayo futhi umugqa wokuqala omubi uyaboniswa.
